newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Kinkel says up to Iran to end envoy row.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kinkel says up to Iran to end envoy row.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel on Monday blamed Iran for a diplomatic row over the country's refusal to accept the return of the German and Danish envoys to Tehran.
"It is not us but Iran who has caused this situation and it is up to Iran to put it back into order," a Foreign Ministry spokesman quoted Kinkel as saying.
Kinkel said the European Union would not allow anybody to divide it in its attitude towards Iran and said the EU's ambassadors would not return to Tehran for the time being.
Iran said last Wednesday neither the German nor the Danish ambassador was welcome back in the country after the EU agreed to send its envoys back.
The EU initially withdrew its representatives last month after a German court implicated Iranian leaders in the 1992 killing of four Kurdish dissidents in Berlin.
